teaser.text: Nongfu Spring is a beverage maker whose products travel from factories and water sources through distributors and shops to the person who drinks them. To understand its business, follow two flows at once: what people buy, and how each yuan of company revenue is divided among making, selling, administration, tax and profit.

stock.title: Nongfu Spring stock forecast
stock.meta_description: Nongfu Spring stock forecast with weighted scenarios, cash conversion, valuation and the risks that could change the outcome.
stock.opening: Nongfu Spring's weighted scenario is HKD40.61 in October 2027, a 2% return including dividends. It hinges on whether tea-led earnings growth continues and whether the market keeps paying a premium for those earnings.
stock.closing: The full Nongfu Spring memo also answers how Nongfu Spring makes money, who its rivals are, how management is steering it, and what risks could change the forecast.

blocks.heading: Where could Nongfu Spring's shares go by October 2029?

paragraphs.text: The forecast points to limited weighted share-price gains, but a very wide range of outcomes. Including dividends, the weighted price is HKD40.61 in October 2027, HKD42.08 in October 2028 and HKD43.62 in October 2029, equal to returns of 2%, 9% and 16% from today’s HKD41.12.

blocks.heading: What has to go right or wrong for Nongfu Spring?

paragraphs.text: The base earnings path rises through October 2029 because tea remains the growth engine, water stabilizes below its 2023 level, and margins remain near recent levels. The bear path is nearly flat because discounting, trust damage and weaker tea repeat purchases reduce growth and margins. The bull path accelerates because tea and functional drinks convert distribution into repeat demand, water recovers and mix protects margins. Management’s double-digit 2026 sales and profit ambition, alongside consensus profit of about CNY18,007m, supports the base case but does not prove delivery.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Nongfu Spring really make?

paragraphs.text: Free cash flow is the cash left after ordinary operations and necessary investment. In 2025, operating cash inflow was RMB21,141.652 million, while property, plant and equipment absorbed RMB6,481.304 million. Inventory absorbed another RMB916.212 million, showing why accounting profit and distributable cash can diverge.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay today for Nongfu Spring?

paragraphs.text: The trailing P/E, or price-to-earnings ratio, says how much investors pay for each yuan of recent profit. The forward P/E uses forecast profit instead. The lower forward multiple therefore embeds roughly one-fifth earnings growth, not a guaranteed return.

dividend.title: Nongfu Spring dividend
dividend.meta_description: Nongfu Spring's dividend per share rose every year from 2021 to 2025; FY2025 dividends used 60.5% of free cash flow.
dividend.opening: Nongfu Spring's dividend per share rose every year from 2021 to 2025, and the base forecast raises it from CNY1.10 to CNY1.30. In 2025, dividends used 60.5% of free cash flow, after 188.6% in 2024.
dividend.closing: The full memo also explains Nongfu Spring's business, its rivals, its management, and its risks.

blocks.heading: How much does Nongfu Spring pay per share?

paragraphs.text: Base dividends rise from CNY1.10 to CNY1.30 per share. The bear case cuts first and recovers slowly; the bull case reaches CNY1.65 because earnings and cash generation are stronger. DPS rose every year from 2021 to 2025, and net cash was CNY27,005.353m at June 2026. But there is no preset payout ratio, while capital commitments were about CNY3,970m.

blocks.heading: Does Nongfu Spring's dividend come from its cash?

paragraphs.text: Dividends were the main distribution. In 2024, Nongfu generated RMB4,472.336 million of free cash flow but paid RMB8,434.85 million in dividends. That payout equalled 188.6% of free cash flow, so accumulated cash, investments and borrowing helped cover the difference. Net cash fell from RMB21,004.591 million at the end of 2023 to RMB8,626.053 million at the end of 2024. In 2025, dividend coverage recovered to 60.5% of free cash flow. One shortfall can use the existing cushion; repeated ones would compete directly with factory investment.

blocks.heading: What could change Nongfu Spring's dividend?

paragraphs.text: By 2028–2029, packaging and freight costs, factory utilization, free cash flow and dividend decisions will determine whether margins and cash conversion justify the assumed multiple. A firmer multiple would require evidence that growth is repeatable, not merely the result of initial channel stocking.

blocks.heading: What is Nongfu Spring's dividend yield today?

paragraphs.text: The dividend yield is below the free cash flow yield, but the board has no preset payout ratio. Only a minority of shares forms the public float, so marginal buying or selling can move the quoted price more sharply.
